name: @repo/ai-context-meter
description: Context window meter whose ring fills and shifts hue at the warning threshold, never changing size.

useCases: Context window usage next to a composer
Token budget indicator in a settings row
Any quota that has a soft warning band
compositionHints: Crossing the threshold changes hue, not size — growth would imply progress
Figures are tabular so the number never jitters as it counts
Pass a breakdown to explain what is filling the window
